title: Implement user authentication with OAuth 2.0 providers
description: Set up OAuth 2.0 authentication flow with Google, GitHub, and Microsoft providers.

title: Fix memory leak in dashboard component causing browser slowdown
description: The dashboard component re-renders without proper cleanup of event listeners and subscriptions, causing memory usage to grow over time.

title: Update API documentation for v2 endpoints
description: Document all new v2 REST endpoints with request/response schemas, authentication requirements, and usage examples.

title: Add dark mode support for all UI components
description: Implement dark mode toggle that persists user preference and applies theme across all shadcn/ui components.

title: Resolve login page not redirecting after successful authentication
description: After successful sign-in, the user stays on the login page instead of being redirected to the dashboard.

title: Create onboarding tutorial for new users
description: Design and implement an interactive onboarding flow with tooltips and guided steps for first-time users.

title: Optimize database queries for user dashboard
description: Profile and optimize slow Firestore queries on the user dashboard. Add composite indexes where needed.

title: Refactor notification service for better maintainability
description: Break down the monolithic notification service into smaller, testable modules with clear separation of concerns.

title: Fix broken image upload on mobile devices
description: Image uploads fail silently on iOS Safari and Android Chrome. Investigate the file reading and form-data submission logic.

title: Implement real-time notifications using WebSockets
description: Replace polling-based notification system with WebSocket connections for instant push notifications.

title: Write unit tests for payment processing module
description: Add comprehensive unit tests covering payment validation, retry logic, and error handling paths.

title: Update README with installation instructions
description: Refresh the README with clear step-by-step installation, configuration, and running instructions.

title: Design and implement user profile settings page
description: Create a settings page where users can update their display name, avatar, email preferences, and notification settings.

title: Fix timezone conversion issues in calendar view
description: Events display in UTC instead of the user's local timezone. Use date-fns-tz or native Intl API for correct conversion.

title: Refactor legacy authentication code to use new security standards
description: Audit and refactor all authentication-related code to comply with OWASP recommendations and modern best practices.

title: Add export functionality for analytics reports
description: Allow users to export analytics data as CSV and PDF. Implement server-side generation for large datasets.

title: Create API rate limiting documentation
description: Document rate limit tiers, headers, backoff strategies, and best practices for API consumers.

title: Resolve CSS styling conflicts in sidebar navigation
description: Sidebar active state styles are overridden by global CSS resets. Use more specific selectors and CSS variables.

title: Implement lazy loading for dashboard widgets
description: Use React Suspense and dynamic imports to lazy load non-critical dashboard widgets to improve initial load time.

title: Add multi-language support for user interface
description: Integrate next-intl to support English and Vietnamese with language switcher and RTL layout support.

title: Fix form validation errors not displaying correctly
description: Validation error messages disappear when the form field is blurred. Ensure errors persist until the field is corrected.

title: Write migration guide from v1 to v2
description: Comprehensive migration guide covering breaking changes, deprecated API replacements, and step-by-step upgrade instructions.

title: Refactor data fetching hooks for better reusability
description: Extract shared data fetching logic into reusable custom hooks with built-in caching and error handling.

title: Implement file drag and drop upload feature
description: Add drag-and-drop zone for file uploads with progress indicators, file type validation, and size limits.

title: Fix search functionality returning incorrect results
description: Search queries with special characters return empty results. Escape regex metacharacters before querying Firestore.

title: Improve error handling across all API endpoints
description: Standardize error responses across all API routes with consistent status codes, error codes, and user-friendly messages.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts documentation
description: Document all keyboard shortcuts available in the application for power users.

title: Implement two-factor authentication option
description: Add TOTP-based 2FA with QR code setup, backup codes, and recovery flow.

title: Resolve session timeout not working properly
description: User sessions persist beyond the configured 30-minute timeout. Fix token refresh logic and idle detection.

title: Refactor component library for better tree shaking
description: Audit bundle size and restructure exports so that unused components are tree-shaken properly by webpack.

title: Add accessibility improvements for screen readers
description: Ensure all interactive elements have proper ARIA labels, focus management, and keyboard navigation support.

title: Create troubleshooting guide for common issues
description: Write a FAQ/troubleshooting page covering the most common support issues with step-by-step resolutions.

title: Implement bulk action operations for data tables
description: Allow users to select multiple rows and perform bulk actions: delete, update status, and reassign in one operation.

title: Fix notification badge count not updating in real-time
description: The notification bell badge count only updates on page reload. Integrate with the notification stream to refresh live.

title: Optimize image compression for faster page loads
description: Integrate an image CDN with automatic WebP/AVIF conversion, resizing, and CDN caching headers.

title: Add SSO integration for enterprise customers
description: Implement SAML 2.0 and OIDC-based SSO for enterprise clients with just-in-time user provisioning.

title: Document component props and usage examples
description: Generate Storybook stories for all reusable UI components with prop documentation and interactive examples.

title: Fix data export generating corrupted files
description: Exported CSV files are missing rows and have incorrect column alignment. Fix the streaming write buffer logic.

title: Refactor state management to use Zustand
description: Migrate from Context API to Zustand for global state management to improve performance and developer experience.

title: Implement custom dashboard layout builder
description: Allow users to customize their dashboard by dragging, resizing, and hiding widgets. Persist layout in user preferences.

title: Add performance monitoring and alerting
description: Integrate performance monitoring tools to track API latency, Core Web Vitals, and set up alerting for degradation.

title: Fix dropdown menu not closing on outside click
description: Dropdown menus remain open after clicking outside. Ensure Radix UI popper properly handles outside click events.

title: Create video tutorials for key features
description: Record and produce short video walkthroughs for the most-used features to improve user onboarding.

title: Implement advanced search filters
description: Add multi-field search with filters for date range, assignee, status, and tags. Include save-search functionality.

title: Refactor API client for better error recovery
description: Implement exponential backoff retry logic, circuit breaker pattern, and graceful degradation in the API client.

title: Fix chart rendering issues on Safari browser
description: Recharts bar charts are not rendering correctly in Safari 17. Investigate SVG rendering differences and CSS clipping.

title: Add automated backup functionality
description: Implement scheduled daily backups of Firestore data to Google Cloud Storage with point-in-time recovery support.

title: Improve loading states across the application
description: Add skeleton loaders and descriptive loading messages instead of generic spinners throughout the app.

title: Write integration tests for checkout flow
description: Cover the entire checkout flow including payment processing, confirmation emails, and webhook handling with Playwright.

title: Fix email notifications being marked as spam
description: Review SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records. Ensure email templates follow best practices to avoid spam filters.
